summary: Security-fix verification (SEC-001, SEC-002, P3) + auth/core regression + SmartImage frontend regression — ALL PASS. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py. SEC-001: POST /api/register-push without token -> 401 (fixed); with valid board@fam.com bearer -> 500 (EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY placeholder, expected & explicitly not treated as failure). SEC-002: POST /api/upload (board) then GET /api/files/{path} => same-family token 200, no token 401, cross-family throwaway token 404. Throwaway user was registered fresh, given its own family via POST /api/families, and torn down via DELETE /api/auth/account (whole family purged since throwaway is admin). Also verified GET /api/files/{path}?token= == 200 (the SmartImage web path). P3: admin (board) POST /api/families/members returned 200 and the created member appeared in GET /api/families/members. REGRESSION auth+core: /api/auth/me and 6 authed GETs (/home, /families/members, /events, /notices, /vault/items, /emergency/medical) all 200. Frontend regression (Expo web @ 375x812, board@fam.com/secret123): Home dashboard, Family screen and Board Demo member profile all render — 0 broken across all screens, 0 failed /api/files responses. Note the Sharma demo seeds member photos from Unsplash CDN (not /api/files) so avatars load without needing the auth header/token; SmartImage still resolves /api/files with ?token= on web (verified 200 via backend test). No red screens, no console errors beyond the expected expo-notifications web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4189-4200 /api/register-push now depends on get_current_user and binds device to user['user_id'], explicitly ignoring body.user_id — SEC-001 fix looks correct. 401->500 mapping for upstream 401 is fine so a placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY surfaces as 500.

server.py:4160-4177 GET /api/files/{path} looks up the media record and enforces owner_fid == user.family_id, returning 404 for cross-family (BOLA fix) and 404 for missing/legacy-with-unknown-family. get_current_user still supports both Authorization header (native) and ?token= query (web), which SmartImage relies on.

server.py:699-717 POST /api/families/members guards with role in (admin, parent) — admin path verified. 403-for-non-parent path was not exercised (only admin credential available) but the code path is trivially correct.

frontend/src/lib/api.ts:66-79 mediaImageSource returns { uri, headers: Authorization } on native and { uri: `${url}?token=${authToken}` } on web for /api/ paths, and passes external URLs (Unsplash) through as-is. Verified in preview: Unsplash CDN avatars still render on Home/Family/Profile, and backend test confirmed the ?token= path yields 200 for uploaded /api/files/ media.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Home + Family + Profile screens render all avatars with 0 broken images and 0 failed /api/files responses

seed_data_creation: Throwaway user TEST_throwaway_<uuid>@fam.com registered and its throwaway family created solely for the cross-family BOLA test; both fully deleted via DELETE /api/auth/account at fixture teardown. TEST_p3_<uuid> member created by P3 test — the app has no DELETE /api/families/members endpoint so test's HTTP cleanup was a no-op; leftover member was purged directly from mongo (db.members.delete_many({name: /^TEST_p3_/})) after the run.

The first-load 'Tap to close' overlay dismisses via [data-testid=affection-dismiss] or [data-testid=affection-close]; if not present, tap home-avatar / any tab instead — do NOT synthesize a center-screen click (it can hit home-emergency). Sharma demo member photos are Unsplash CDN URLs (not /api/files/), so filesCount:0 in a rendered stats snapshot is normal — the /api/files auth path was independently confirmed via backend test (GET /api/files/{path}?token= == 200 same-family, 401 no auth, 404 cross-family). There is NO DELETE /api/families/members endpoint; if a test creates members, purge them via mongo directly (db.members.delete_many).
